// SR Flip-Flop module
module origen_106816 (
    input wire s, r, clk, rst,
    output reg q,
    output wire qb
);

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst)
            q <= 1'b0;
        else if (s && !r)
            q <= 1'b1;
        else if (!s && r)
            q <= 1'b0;
    end

    assign qb = ~q;

endmodule

// Testbench
module srfftb;
    reg s, r, clk, rst;
    wire q, qb;

    // Instantiate the SR flip-flop
    srff uut (
        .s(s),
        .r(r),
        .clk(clk),
        .rst(rst),
        .q(q),
        .qb(qb)
    );

    // Clock generation
    initial begin
        clk = 0;
        forever #5 clk = ~clk;
    end

    // Stimulus
    initial begin
        s = 0; r = 0; rst = 1;
        #100 rst = 0;
        
        repeat (10) begin
            #40 s = ~s;
            #60 r = ~r;
        end

        #500 $finish;
    end

    // Monitor
    initial begin
        $monitor("Time=%0t s=%b r=%b rst=%b q=%b qb=%b", $time, s, r, rst, q, qb);
    end

endmodule
